title: VP Recent-Sequence Cascade — a coupled Flood→Glaciation→Atlantic-opening relaxation on a jammed-water substrate
abstract: A single conserved relaxation governed by the R19 kernel — one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir (S0) — couples a Flood, a glaciation and an Atlantic opening on a jammed-water substrate, and drives a glaciation-driven petroleum strand.
